package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type LearningPathStateRepository interface {
	GetLearningPathByID(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
	ListLearningPaths(ctx context.Context, studentID string, limit int) ([]domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
	GetLearningContext(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningContext, error)
	ActivateLearningPath(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		pathID string,
		expectedJourneyVersion int64,
		makePrimary bool,
		now time.Time,
	) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error)
	PauseLearningPath(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		pathID string,
		expectedJourneyVersion int64,
		now time.Time,
	) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error)
	ResumeLearningPath(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		pathID string,
		expectedJourneyVersion int64,
		now time.Time,
	) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error)
}

type LearningPathCreationRequest struct {
	ExpectedOnboardingVersion int64
	ExpectedDirectionCode     string
	IdempotencyKey            string
	PlanningRequestID         string
	RequestHash               string
}

type IdempotentLearningPathRepository interface {
	CreateLearningPathIdempotently(
		ctx context.Context,
		path domain.StudentLearningPath,
		request LearningPathCreationRequest,
	) (domain.StudentLearningPath, bool, error)
}

type LearningPathPlanningRepository interface {
	GetLearningPathPlanningState(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		pathID string,
	) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error)
	ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(
		ctx context.Context,
		command domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand,
	) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, bool, error)
}

type LearningJourneyRepository interface {
	GetLearningPath(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
	ReplaceLearningPath(ctx context.Context, path domain.StudentLearningPath, expectedVersion int64) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
	SaveDiagnosticSnapshot(ctx context.Context, snapshot domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error)
	GetLatestDiagnosticSnapshot(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error)
	CreateLearningSession(ctx context.Context, session domain.StudentLearningSession) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	GetLearningSession(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	UpdateLearningSession(ctx context.Context, session domain.StudentLearningSession, expectedVersion int64) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	ListRecentLearningSessions(ctx context.Context, studentID string, limit int) ([]domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
}
